name: Mainframe
description: The Mainframe, a capital ship a kilometre long: a faceted armoured hull of laser-cut plate, a berth in its keel for a Zero Day, a dorsal hangar for three Shuttles, four Limpet pockets, a vault of robot shells, two missile fields, four fusion reactors and six drive bells, decks of rooms joined by lifts and a corridor the length of the ship, and airlocks all along both flanks.
